acknowledged.detail: vendor serves active_meetings: [ActiveMeeting!]; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Meetings in progress right now. Backlot serves a fixed corpus, so there is no live state to report.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves analytics: Analytics!; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Workspace-wide meeting analytics. Per-meeting MeetingAnalytics IS served on Transcript; the aggregate rollup is not modelled.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves apps: Apps; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Third-party app outputs. No corpus carries them; the Apps wrapper is served on Transcript because Fireflies serves it even when empty.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves askfred_thread: AskFredThread; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: AskFred is Fireflies' own LLM assistant. Serving it would mean generating answers, which Backlot deliberately does not.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves askfred_threads: [AskFredThreadSummary!]; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: AskFred is Fireflies' own LLM assistant. Serving it would mean generating answers, which Backlot deliberately does not.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves auditEvents: AuditEventsResponse!; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Workspace audit log — account administration, not meeting content.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves bite: Bite; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Bites are user-authored clips of a transcript, a write product. Backlot's data enters through `backlot import`.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves bites: [Bite!]!; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Bites are user-authored clips of a transcript, a write product. Backlot's data enters through `backlot import`.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves channel: Channel; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Channel is served as a type; the by-id root is not, because no corpus states channel membership.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves channels: [Channel!]!; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Channel is served as a type; the root listing is not, because no corpus states channel membership.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves contacts: [Contact!]!; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: CRM contacts synced into Fireflies from an external system, which is a different source's corpus.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves live_action_items: [LiveActionItem!]!; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Action items extracted from a meeting in progress. Same reason as active_meetings.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves rule_executions_by_meeting: RuleExecutionsByMeetingResponse!; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Automation-rule run history. Backlot runs no automations.

acknowledged.detail: vendor serves user_groups: [UserGroup!]; Backlot does not
acknowledged.note: Account membership state. Backlot's ACL groups are a permission mechanism and are deliberately not served under this name.
